modelSet: AggregateTacticalLevel.sms -> AggregateLevelBase.sms -> base.sms (VR-Forces 5.2d, C:\MAK\vrforces5.2d\data\simulationModelSets). The AGGREGATE-LEVEL profile (Y-15, RL-20260927-01): select with Vrf:ModelSet=AggregateTacticalLevel (runner -ModelSet AggregateTacticalLevel), which names THIS file as Vrf:TypeMapFile, and pair it with a fixture on the same SMS (tools/FixtureGen/frame_variants/IronStorm_Centre_52_Aggregate.scnx). Never pair it with an EntityLevel fixture: these object types do not exist there. Derived 2026-09-27 from the installed catalogue; every row is re-proved against the installed chain by typemap_check.py.
notes: SAME schema and key logic as data/unit-type-map-52.json (UnitTypeMap.Lookup: (b) functionId + SIDC echelon char, (c) functionId + C2SIM EchelonCode, (d) echelon-only row, (e) the nation's catch-all). modelSetKey, role, entityFile and magx are ADDITIONS the app ignores (UnitTypeMap.Parse reads named fields only); the runner reads modelSetKey to refuse a fixture/type-map mismatch.

objectType is the EIGHT-field form (superType 3 = kind-11 unit). It is the type the .entity template PUBLISHES and it is resolved against the installed chain by typemap_check.py; the .magx (a vrfGui element-definition map, UG52 Table 10 p172) is recorded in 'magx' when one names the same type. Where the vendor's .magx disagrees with its own .entity the .entity wins (the sim picks templates by .entity matchType) - see H-GS-H.

EVERY ROW NAMES A WARFARE-MODEL UNIT ('role': UNIT, AggregateLevelAggregate.ope): one simulated object with combat power, health and a footprint that moves by itself (UG52 27.1 p528). No row names an Aggregate Container: an EMPTY container's Move Along Route ends at once without moving (AggregateLevelBase\scripts\PA_Move_Along_Route.lua tick()), and the interface cannot populate one from a flat C2SIM unit. Populated containers (Armor CAB Group (USA), Stryker Cavalry SQDN PA (USA), BTG PA ...) are the vendor-faithful NEXT step once a leaf has moved live (G1).

fidelity EXACT = right branch AND echelon AND nation; PROXY = a real template of the wrong branch, echelon or nation, surfaced to C2SIM per R-SURFACE-PROXY. The catalogue has NO warfare-model unit at BDE, DIV or CORPS for any nation, so every Iron Storm unit is a PROXY here, as it was on the entity-level map.

No row names a type the app's catalogue resolver would EXPAND: that resolver is rooted at EntityLevel.sms (ObjectTypeResolver.LoadChain default, VrfC2SimService.cs GetResolver), and under Vrf:CreationPolicy=AtOrder MaterializeUnit expands any type whose ENTITY-level twin is a pure higher unit into entity-level sub-unit types that land base-sim-aggregate in this SMS. typemap_check.py fails such a row.

HOSTILE NATION IS AN OWNER DECISION (not decided here): the map carries RUS (DIS 260; 131 ground templates, 107 warfare-model units) and BLR (DIS 246; 31 ground templates, 24 units) hostile rows. Vrf:OpposingNation selects; its pre-existing default in appsettings.json is RUS. RUS here is DIS 260, not the 222 the entity-level map uses.
functionId / echelon / echelonCode follow data/unit-type-map-52.json exactly ('' = echelon-only row, '*' = catch-all, '-' = empty SIDC echelon field).
